chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Bob Ysaguirre and Milt Hinton as bassists he played with
summary: Ysaguirre was a foundation bass in Redman's band; Jackson says he learned from watching Hinton for eight and a half years.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Now, after him, when I went to Don's band, Bob Ysaguirre was there. Bob was a good, just a foundation bass player. No solos, no nothing, but you knew he was there. That's how he could stay.
Then, -- I was with him all that time in Don's band, and the next great bass player I got to was you.
That was the next great bass player, was Milton John Hinton.
That was it, beautiful eight and a half years that I learned a whole lot about the instrument from you. I used to listen to you and watch you. I used to watch every move you made, little do you know.
